products.title: boAt Bassheads 102 in-Ear Wired Earphones with Mic
products.description: boAt Bassheads 102 wired earphones deliver powerful bass with an in-line mic and remote control for hands-free calls. Lightweight in-ear design with silicone ear tips for a snug fit.

reviews.author: Rahul S.
reviews.title: Amazing bass quality
reviews.body: Best earphones under 500 rupees. Bass is deep and mic works perfectly for calls.

reviews.author: Priya K.
reviews.title: Good value
reviews.body: Build quality is decent for the price. Sound is clear and fits well.

reviews.author: Amit R.
reviews.title: Average durability

products.title: Redmi Note 13 Pro 5G - 8GB RAM, 256GB Storage

reviews.author: Sneha M.
reviews.title: Excellent display
reviews.body: AMOLED screen is vibrant and the camera clicks sharp photos in daylight.

reviews.author: Vikram J.
reviews.title: Smooth performance
reviews.body: Gaming and multitasking are lag-free. Battery lasts a full day.

reviews.author: Kavita L.
reviews.title: Heats up slightly

products.title: Samsung Galaxy F14 5G - 8GB RAM, 128GB Storage

reviews.author: Arjun D.
reviews.title: Samsung quality at this price

reviews.author: Meera V.
reviews.title: Good 5G phone
reviews.body: Battery lasts a full day of mixed use. Camera clicks good photos in daylight.

reviews.author: Kartik N.
reviews.title: Average performance

reviews.author: Neha P.

reviews.author: Rohit T.
reviews.title: Good battery life
reviews.body: 30 hours is real. Quick charging works well. ANC is average but enough for office.

reviews.author: Simran K.

products.title: HP Victus 15-fb0040AX Gaming Laptop - i5, RTX 3050

reviews.author: Pooja M.

reviews.author: Ravi K.
reviews.title: Average battery life

products.title: Apple MacBook Air M2 - 8GB RAM, 256GB SSD

reviews.author: Sneha M.
reviews.title: Premium build quality

reviews.author: Vikram J.
